hypothesis: The 1D phi^4 field (stochastic Allen-Cahn) at temperature T on a lattice of spacing h is an exactly Markov, stationary, reversible chain whose kernel is a Gaussian step tilted by a function of the arrival point (markov_score.field). It is a second laboratory, structurally different from the AR(1) family (the two intersect only at the Gaussian chain), on which the paper's reference machinery (exact BP, the linear floor, the quadrature grid) and Theorem 2 can be exercised. Proposed by Jerome Garnier-Brun and Marc Mezard, email of 1 October 2026.
design: Deterministic. spectrum: the (T, h) map of lambda_1/lambda_0, correlation length, scale, marginal kurtosis and grid resolution, plus the iso-correlation line h*(T) at lambda_1/lambda_0 = 0.85 (the laboratory's frozen rho). ladder: on the six confirmatory cells (T sweep at matched correlation: T in 0.3, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0 with h = 1, h*(0.5), h*(1), h*(2), all L = 32; refinement at fixed physical length from the T = 0.3 cell: (h, L) = (0.5, 64), (0.25, 128)), 512 stationary chains x 2 reps at the twelve levels: exact BP (reference), LMMSE of the true covariance, the isotropic map, and the moment-projected recursion with its edge-mass diagnostic. refinement: the exact score at (401, 8) and (801, 8) against (1601, 8) on the same data. theory: kappa_4 of the chain by transfer-matrix four-point functions, C4 = ||kappa_4||_F^2 / 6, and the measured closure gap E||S - S^G||^2 e^{8t} / C4 per level on the four L = 32 cells.

predeclared_predictions.P1: the operating grid's exact score is within 1e-3 relative of the (1601, 8) one at every level of every cell. FALSIFIED by any cell above 1e-2, which moves that cell to a finer grid in E33.
predeclared_predictions.P2: the moment-projected recursion is NOT well-posed on this chain: at some level of every cell its backward messages carry more than 10% of their mass in the outer 5% of the operating grid (the message is nearly flat because the kernel pulls any far state back to a' ~ a^(1/3)), so the Gaussian-closure arm of the field chain is its covariance twin, as Proposition 1 identifies the two on linear transitions. FALSIFIED if the edge mass stays below 10% at every level of some cell.
predeclared_predictions.P3: the closure-gap ratio measured/predicted approaches 1 above t_* on every L = 32 cell, as for the AR(1) families (E01): Theorem 2 holds on the second laboratory with its own constant.

predeclared_analysis: spectrum.csv and iso.csv fix the cells (recorded in cells.json with the achieved rho_1). ladder.csv: pooled and per-level relative score error per arm, rep; the floor per cell is the number E33's P6 refers to. refinement.csv: worst relative error of (401, 8) per cell over levels, the gate for E33. theory.csv: ratio per level and cell.

seeds.deterministic: rng_for('e32-ladder' | 'e32-refine', T, h, L, rep), reps 0-1
